publication issues.summary: This is a partial, unapproved review of the selected DN001 baseline. The selected model, raw and text remain unchanged; the paired V4 conversion is diagnostic only. Historical card 3308 and human-review information is retained in its original narrow scope. The native scan, block-registered and independently seeded edge-label overlays, 25 overlapping route sections, and indexed junction and crossing panels support inspection. The ledger maps 85 routes (225 segments), 43 junctions and 172 unjoined crossings into local sections. The parent viewed those sections and point panels; a read-only child sampled the native scan and six overlapping native regions. This is not proof of every route end to end, of omitted wires, or of electrical connectivity. The two automatic fits disagree by up to 12.85 render pixels at sampled positions; local offsets and scan deformation remain limitations. The converter emitted eight differences: header cells [235,0], [236,0], [237,0] and wiring cells [115,47], [137,58], [114,68], [137,77], [130,90]. The last three are existing junction records for E00POS, AH and E03NEG; the first two have no exact-point junction or crossing record. All eight were inspected and remain unresolved. Converter zero formal uncertainties does not resolve inherited review holds. The original printed label B02✲ at index 77 is retained. Its asterisk does not establish a physical pin. Unlabelled logical pins, targetless outputs, nine repeated-coordinate segments, and the distinction between crossings and junctions remain as recorded. No connectivity is inferred from a crossing. The V4 content digest matches its review sidecar; full external schema validation was not run. See the immutable manifest, route and crossing ledger, junction ledger, conversion report and image panels for bindings and evidence. No canonical or shared source was changed. Native, source, electrical, full trace and omission claims remain bounded by source review. Current selected json differs from candidate source; historical mismatch retained. The candidate source does not fully match the previous local selection: model match False, text match True. The previous selection is preserved in the publication receipt.
publication issues.qualification: Published for access with the recorded review limitations; no electrical correctness or user approval asserted.
